article_limitations: No figures or supplements are listed for this article; no visual task applies.
Clinical data are table-based; no dates, dermatitis course, treatment duration or outcomes are stated per patient.
Patch test grades (1+, 2+, 3+) are kept as ordinal text; the grading scale is not defined in the source.
The Day-4 reading and 48-hour occlusion are footnote-level and apply to all table results.
Table lists spondylarthritis while the footnote abbreviation list defines PsA; no psoriatic arthritis is recorded.

Cohort conclusions (b00003, b00004) are not copied to individuals, except that b00003 "All reactions were clinically relevant" is cited with Patient 5's unspecified "Relevant" cell. Patient 6 relevance cell "—" is not recorded as a fact.
Positive patch tests are recorded as contact allergies only with the row's relevance statement; Patient 4 cobalt is review_only because its relevance is unresolved.
